checks.lead: Şehzade Mustafa (Ottoman Turkish: شهزاده مصطفى; c. 1516/1517 – 6 October 1553) was an Ottoman prince, son of sultan Suleiman the Magnificent and his concubine Mahidevran Hatun. Mustafa was Suleiman's oldest surviving son, governor of Manisa from 1533 to 1541 and of Amasya from 1541 to 1553, when he was executed by his father's order on charges of sedition and treason.
